newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia, France discuss military cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia, France discuss military cooperation.

text.p: Indonesia's armed forces chief General Feisal Tanjung said on Tuesday he would discuss defence cooperation with the visiting joint chief of staff of the French armed forces, General Jean-Philippe Douin.
"We will discuss how to increase defence cooperation in the fields of education and defence technology," Tanjung told reporters after accompanying Douin to a meeting with President Suharto.
"We will have an exchange of views and experience in the army field," Douin said.
Tanjung said Douin would also meet Indonesia's Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie to discuss cooperation in the field of technology.
Douin arrived in Jakarta on Monday and is due to leave again on Wednesday.
